generic.title: Chinese Dialect Atlas
generic.description: Explore dialect phonology, lexical resources, and geographic patterns.

menuEntry.title: Feature Navigation
menuEntry.description: Open query, comparison, map, phonology, corpus, village, and tool entries.

menuAboutIntro.title: About Chinese Dialect Atlas
menuAboutIntro.description: View the site's features, development history, acknowledgments, and more.

menuAboutSuggestion.title: Feedback Entry
menuAboutSuggestion.description: Open an issue on GitHub, send suggestions through Zhihu AI-works, or submit feedback directly on this site.

menuAboutLike.title: Support
menuAboutLike.description: View the project repository and the author's development reflections, or scan a QR code to support the author.

menuQueryZhonggu.title: Middle Chinese Query
menuQueryZhonggu.description: Search historical phonological categories in rhyme books, such as Guangyun rime groups, rimes, divisions, openness, and initials, to organize modern character readings across dialects and their geographic distribution. Query multiple locations and draw maps for historical phonology and geolinguistic analysis.

menuQueryChar.title: Character Query
menuQueryChar.description: Look up Chinese character IPA readings, historical phonological categories, and notes across dialects, including multiple readings, literary and colloquial forms, and maps.

menuQueryYinwei.title: Phoneme Query
menuQueryYinwei.description: Enter the actual sound values of dialect initials, finals, or tones to trace their rhyme-book sources, including Middle Chinese rime groups, rimes, initials, and openness categories in Guangyun. View character counts, proportions, and examples for each source.

menuQueryTone.title: Tone Query
menuQueryTone.description: Look up tones across dialects, including tone-category mergers and the geographic distribution of specific pitch values.

menuMapView.title: Map View
menuMapView.description: Map results from character, Middle Chinese, phoneme, and tone queries; character, historical-category, and tone-category comparisons; and dialect divisions. Click locations for details and draw syllable contour maps, heatmaps, and more. Explore and visualize dialect distribution from a geolinguistic perspective.

menuMapDivide.title: Map Regions
menuMapDivide.description: Look up atlas or Yindian classifications for dialect locations, draw dialect division maps by classification level, and explore dialect divisions and their geographic distribution from a geolinguistic perspective.

menuMapCustom.title: Personal Map Data
menuMapCustom.description: Sign in to add and manage personal dialect survey data, including phonological features, character pronunciations, and tone values, and create custom dialect maps. Data is linked to your account and synchronized across devices.

menuCompareChar.title: Character Comparison
menuCompareChar.description: Compare the initials, finals, or tones of two Chinese characters across dialects, and map locations where they match, partly match, or differ.

menuCompareZhonggu.title: Middle Chinese Comparison
menuCompareZhonggu.description: Compare two sets of historical rhyme-book category conditions, such as Middle Chinese categories in Guangyun, in modern dialect initials, finals, or tones. Explore mergers, splits, and their geographic distribution.

menuCompareTone.title: Tone Comparison
menuCompareTone.description: Compare mergers between two tone categories across dialects, and map locations with mergers, possible mergers, or distinctions.

menuComparePhonetic.title: Phonology Comparison
menuComparePhonetic.description: Select 2 to 5 dialect locations and compare initial, final, or tone correspondences, using Sankey diagrams to show sound-category mergers and splits.

menuResult.title: Results
menuResult.description: Result pages for character, Middle Chinese, phoneme, and tone queries.

menuPhoMatrix.title: Phonology Query
menuPhoMatrix.description: View a dialect location's complete phonology table, initial-final-tone combinations, and homophone lexicon, with tables showing how initials, finals, and tones combine.

menuPhoCustom.title: Phoneme Classification
menuPhoCustom.description: Choose three rhyme-book classification dimensions, such as voicing, articulation, openness, or rime group, to organize dialect initials, finals, and tones. Classify sound categories and view their counts and example characters.

menuPhoCount.title: Syllable Statistics
menuPhoCount.description: Count syllables for a dialect location and render charts and isogloss maps, with separate modes for initials/finals/tones, toneless syllables, and toned syllables.

menuPhoEvolution.title: Evolution
menuPhoEvolution.description: Examine how a dialect location's initials, finals, and tones correspond to Middle Chinese and rhyme-book categories. Use pie and Sankey charts to analyze modern sound origins, category splits, and dialect sound change.

menuSettings.title: Settings
menuSettings.description: Configure language, theme, Middle Chinese query input methods, tutorial visibility, and more.

menuSource.title: Sources
menuSource.description: View the character-table sources, references, and administrative divisions behind the dialect data.

menuPrivacy.title: Privacy
menuPrivacy.description: Learn about this site's privacy policy and citation notes.

menuTools.title: Tools
menuTools.description: Entries for character-table checking and merging, Jyutping conversion, the online Praat tool, GIS drawing tools, and more.

menuVocabularyView.title: Vocabulary Browser
menuVocabularyView.description: Look up dialect vocabulary across China online and compare local expressions, IPA pronunciations, and meanings for the same word across regions. Search standard written words, dialect words, transcriptions, or meanings, and browse vocabulary in card, map, and table views.

menuVocabularyImport.title: Vocabulary Import
menuVocabularyImport.description: Request vocabulary editing permission, provide dialect location details, and upload words, IPA readings, and meanings in the standard format with validation.

menuVocabularyManage.title: Vocabulary Management
menuVocabularyManage.description: Users with editing permission can manage their own dialect vocabulary submissions, edit entries and locations online, replace text in bulk, and add or delete entries.

menuYubao.title: Language Protection Data
menuYubao.description: Sign in to browse 1,000 vocabulary items and 50 grammar sentences from the Chinese Language Resources Protection Project, comparing expressions, pronunciations, and notes in maps, cards, and tables.

menuVillages.title: Village Entry
menuVillages.description: Access natural village lookup, village databases, village-name searches, and village dialect distribution.

menuCluster.title: Dialect Clustering
menuCluster.description: Select dialect locations and phonological features to calculate dialect distance and similarity, run clustering, and view groups and charts.

exploreEntry.title: Explore Navigation
exploreEntry.description: Open tools, character tables, village data, and topic pages.

exploreCheck.title: Character Table Check
exploreCheck.description: Upload dialect character tables to check for non-single-character entries, unusual IPA, and missing tones online. Edit corrections and download the results. Sign-in required.

exploreJyut2Ipa.title: Jyutping to IPA
exploreJyut2Ipa.description: Upload an Excel character table with a Jyutping column to batch-convert Cantonese romanization to IPA online. Customize conversion rules, preview, and download results. Sign-in required.

exploreMerge.title: Character Table Merge
exploreMerge.description: Upload a reference table and multiple dialect Excel tables to align readings and notes by the reference character order, preserve multiple pronunciations, and download the merged results. Sign-in required.

exploreDerive.title: Phonology Derivation
exploreDerive.description: The character table derivation page is a placeholder; derivation is not yet available.

explorePraat.title: Praat Acoustic Analysis
explorePraat.description: Use Praat online for speech acoustic analysis: upload or record audio to view pitch curves, formants, spectrograms, vowel space, and more. Manually select samples to generate five-level tone charts using Shi Feng's T-value method. Sign-in required.

exploreGis.title: Map Drawing
exploreGis.description: Use an online GIS map editor to import geographic data, such as administrative divisions and rivers, edit points, lines, polygons, and text labels in layers, and export GeoJSON or images. Create dialect distribution maps with Voronoi polygons using site data or uploaded dialect locations. Sign-in required.

exploreManage.title: Data Management
exploreManage.description: Manage and maintain the site database. Administrators only.

exploreCharClass.title: Character Set
exploreCharClass.description: Browse Chinese character sets by rhyme-book phonological categories, view characters and annotations, and customize the classification hierarchy and order. Supports Guangyun, Old Chinese, Hongwu Zhengyun, Zhongyuan Yinyun, Menggu Ziyun, and Fenyun Cuoyao.

exploreYcOverview.title: Yangchun Topic
exploreYcOverview.description: Browse a draft overview of Yangchun Yue and Hakka distribution, contact, and phonology. Under development; current AI-generated content requires source verification.

exploreYcWords.title: Yangchun Words
exploreYcWords.description: Look up Yangchun colloquial words with written characters, IPA readings, Jyutping, meanings, and example words and sentences. Filter the vocabulary table by field.

exploreYcExpressions.title: Yangchun Expressions
exploreYcExpressions.description: Browse draft Yangchun idioms, proverbs, and reduplicated expressions by type and pattern. Under development; current AI-generated content requires verification.

exploreYcVillages.title: Yangchun Villages
exploreYcVillages.description: Look up Yangchun natural villages and village committees, browsing their hierarchy within towns and communities.

exploreVillagesToponyms.title: Toponym Search
exploreVillagesToponyms.description: Natural village place-name search and distribution maps are under development. Village and administrative searches are planned; place-name data is currently unavailable.

exploreVillagesGd.title: Guangdong Village Tree
exploreVillagesGd.description: Browse Guangdong natural villages in a tree by city, county, and town. Look up village names, dialect distribution, and coordinates, view villages on a map, and open the map editor to create dialect distribution maps with Voronoi polygons.

exploreVillagesTable.title: Guangdong Village Table
exploreVillagesTable.description: Browse Guangdong natural villages in a table, filter by village name, administrative area, or dialect, and view coordinates, with sorting and pagination.

exploreVillagesMl.title: Village Machine Learning
exploreVillagesMl.description: Analyze Guangdong village naming patterns through character frequencies, semantic categories, geographic hotspots, regional differences, and machine learning clusters.

exploreVillagesAll.title: All Villages
exploreVillagesAll.description: Browse the nationwide natural village directory and complete village database in a tree. Administrators only.

villagesML.title: Village Analysis Workspace
villagesML.description: Analyze the character, semantic, spatial, and clustering features of villages.

auth.title: Account
auth.description: Sign in, register, or view account information, leaderboards, and more.

authData.title: Personal Data
authData.description: View and manage dialect data you have added.

authRegions.title: Personal Regions
authRegions.description: Manage custom dialect regions saved to your account.
